_comment: Conformance fixture, read by two test suites: favorites_test.go here, and
the browser smoke tests in tests/smoke.test.mjs. The Go matcher and the
JavaScript mirror inside index.html must produce identical results for
every case below, which is what keeps the page's highlighting and the
run's alerting from disagreeing about what counts as a favorite.
Add a case here whenever either implementation changes.

normalize.in: Beethoven: Piano Sonata No. 21 in C major "Waldstein", Op.53
normalize.out: beethoven piano sonata no 21 in c major waldstein op 53

normalize.in: Max Bruch: Violinkonzert Nr. 1 g-Moll op. 26
normalize.out: max bruch violinkonzert nr 1 g moll op 26

normalize.in: Franz Schubert: Ouvertüre C-Dur zu »Die Zauberharfe« D 644
normalize.out: franz schubert ouverture c dur zu die zauberharfe d 644

favorites.title: Chopin — Ballade No. 1 in G minor, Op. 23
Beethoven — Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58
Bruch — Violin Concerto No. 1 in G minor, Op. 26
